name: Cyclops
subtitle: One-Eyed Terror
description: Brawler that is resistant to critical hits.
lore: One-eyed giants of Olympus, cyclopes appear in several different varieties. A few, possessed of surprising craft and skill, work to assist gods at the forge or other workshops. Other cyclopes, however, are vicious, savage hunters and marauders who leave ruined villages and half-eaten corpses in their wake. The latter are, unfortunately, far more common, especially since the Shattering.
